turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Once your order ships, you’ll get a tracking number by email—usually within that same 24-48 hour window. Expedited orders ship even faster if placed before noon Eastern.If you haven’t received tracking after a few days, it could be a delay or your order might still be processing.
